answer: Farming becomes a walnut bet on surviving 42 epochs of grading, and every nectar settlement recomputes the kernel schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 42 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 20 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 19 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
